java: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal at lines 224-289 obtains the target in the current namespace context, consumes a GMN sequence value, creates a real NOTE leaf through reallyCreateLeaf, then creates its connector Link.
Plasma.register stores every Quark in an ArrayList and Quark stores children in a LinkedHashMap, so CucaDiagram.leafs at lines 919-929 exposes quark creation order.

CucaDiagramFileMakerSvek passes diagram.leafs into DotData, but GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage at lines 209-229 does not create every SvekNode in that global leaf order: it calls printGroups first and getUnpackagedEntities second.
GraphvizImageBuilder.printGroup at lines 423-437 creates direct package leaves before child groups, while root leaves are deferred until all root groups have been traversed.
Bibliotekon.nodeMap is a LinkedHashMap; createNode inserts into it and allNodes returns its values in insertion order.
SvekResult.drawU at lines 67-99 paints clusters, then every SvekNode from Bibliotekon.allNodes in that insertion order.
Therefore Java paint order is SvekNode construction order from GraphvizImageBuilder's package-first traversal, not one globally monotonic Cuca UID or quark-insertion stream.
rust: ClassUidEvent records package, entity, note, relationship, discarded relationship, and association constructor events; svek_id_allocation replays attached notes as three shared UID slots.
svek_node_emission_order walks rendered packages depth first and appends root entities afterward, matching the high-level Java GraphvizImageBuilder traversal.
The implementation builds one layout_note_emissions vector sorted globally by reconstructed entNNNN sequence and flushes notes while note_sequence < current_entity_sequence.

That merge assumes entity IDs are monotonic in svek_node_emission_order. They are not when a root entity or root note is constructed before a later package whose nodes GraphvizImageBuilder creates first.
render_svek_note_emission has no package traversal key, so the UID sort can move a root note ahead of a package node or leave a package note behind a root node.

findings.summary: The account's global insertion-order invariant is false across package/root traversal boundaries.
findings.evidence: CucaDiagram.leafs is quark insertion ordered, but GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage creates package-tree nodes before unpackaged root nodes. Bibliotekon and SvekResult preserve this later SvekNode construction order, not globally monotonic constructor UID order.

findings.summary: The implementation merges notes with a non-monotonic entity stream using a monotonic UID comparison.
findings.evidence: checker_tb_root_note_before_later_package is an isolated document-order failure: Java emits packaged NestedLedger7811 ent0007 first, but Rust flushes earlier-UID root note GMN3 ent0004 before it. The condition layout_note_sequence < current_entity_sequence is invalid when package-first traversal presents ent0007 before root ent0002/ent0004.

findings.summary: The reverse crossing also fails for a note owned by a package.
findings.evidence: checker_lr_nested_note_before_root_tail expects nested ent0004, nested note ent0006, then root ent0002 and ent0008. Rust advances to RootPrelude7901 ent0002 where Java expects the nested note, leaving the package note until a later root ID exceeds it.
